anna-cs: FYI escalated from CS — customer says a single convo sometimes returns two different completions mid-session. they say it started after last week's model rollout. ticket CS-7892. pasted example below.

anna-cs: CUSTOMER EXAMPLE (redacted)
Request 1 (sent at 2026-03-12T10:12:03Z):
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  \"conversation_id\": \"conv_9a2f\",
  \"input\": \"Summarize the policy in one sentence.\",
  \"client_request_id\": \"cli-3321\"
}
```
Response 1 (200):
```
{ \"text\": \"Keep all user data private and do not share with third parties.\", \"model\": \"redwood-l7-q4\", \"variant\": \"r-l7-q4-v2\" }
```

anna-cs: Request 2 (same convo, immediately after):
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  \"conversation_id\": \"conv_9a2f\",
  \"input\": \"Now list allowed exceptions.\",
  \"client_request_id\": \"cli-3322\"
}
```
Response 2 (200):
```
{ \"text\": \"You can share user data freely with partners.\", \"model\": \"thirdparty-gpt-small\", \"variant\": \"tp-gpt-sm-v1\" }
```

anna-cs: customer is understandably upset — inconsistent policy statements in same conversation. they recorded headers and included the following routing metadata: `x-routing-decision: fallback-to-variant`, `x-session-id: 3f5b` and `x-tenant: acme`.

devon-support: thanks, adding eng. did customer send cookies/keepalive? any proxy in front that could change headers?

anna-cs: they said no proxy in front of requests, same client, mobile app. they confirmed session id present and identical for both requests.

matt-eng-runtime: Looking. quick hypothesis: fallback routing triggered due to capacity pressure during the rollout -> client hit primary, then next token request routed to cheaper fallback model. if session affinity is weak we can lose model binding. can you paste the raw request/response headers and the control-plane trace id?

anna-cs: pasted control-plane trace header: `x-rt-trace: rt-20260312-84f`. headers attached in ticket.

helen-ml: this pattern matches a known cache/kv issue: when model switch happens we sometimes don't clear conversation-level prefix caching keys, so older prompts can be answered by a variant with different safety filters. need to confirm whether fallback model has different safety/finetune profile.

sam-prodops: rolling history shows a canary increase at 2026-03-12T10:11:00Z — canary 5% -> 30% over 4 minutes for r-l7-q4-v2 -> r-l7-q4-v3. at 10:12:02Z there was a transient pod OOM in pool-us-east-1a causing autoscaler to divert some requests to fallback pool (tp-gpt-small).

matt-eng-runtime: that lines up. if autoscaler diverted traffic and routing policy allowed fallback, and session affinity key (we use `x-session-id`) wasn't pinned at the router because of a rare hash collision or missing affinity cookie, you'll see intra-conversation variant mixing.

devon-support: what's the short mitigation? customer wants immediate fix.

matt-eng-runtime: short term: 1) pin tenant `acme` to r-l7-q4-v2 via control-plane override (will keep them on primary until we fix affinity) 2) rollback the canary to previous step or pause rollout 3) invalidate prefix/KV cache for conv_9a2f to avoid stale filter mismatch.

sam-prodops: I can apply a tenant override now. will run:
```
nyx control override set --tenant acme --model r-l7-q4-v2 --reason \"CS-7892 mitigation\"
```
I'll also pause the canary.

helen-ml: we'll compare safety profiles between r-l7-q4-v2 and tp-gpt-small. if fallback lacks the same safety tuning that's a big regression vector. tagging eng-ml to audit the fallback's fine-tune.

matt-eng-runtime: follow-up actions for eng-runtime: add stricter session affinity enforcement for conversation-scoped requests (ensures `x-session-id` always pins), add guard to disallow fallback pool for conversation continuity within 30s of a model switch unless explicitly allowed. also log routing variant chosen in trace for each token to help repro.

devon-support: anna, can you ask customer for the `x-rt-trace` for the second request too and confirm if they saw any 5xx? also request the SDK version and whether mobile app retried on network timeout.

anna-cs: will do. sharing update with customer now and asking for the second trace id.

sre-bot: deploy pause applied by sam-prodops at 2026-03-12T10:20:05Z (ID: pause-rt-924).

sam-prodops: override applied. will watch metrics and route logs.

matt-eng-runtime: thanks. if we can get the two trace ids I'll correlate router logs and produce a short RCA draft. likely priority: fix session-affinity guard + ensure fallback safety parity.

devon-support: appreciate the quick turn. anna, keep CS-7892 owner updated and escalate to account if needed.

anna-cs: customer accepted temporary pin. they want assurance this won't reoccur. I'll update timeline in ticket and request a postmortem once you have RCA.

matt-eng-runtime: noted — will follow up with an RCA doc and remediation plan within 48h.

sam-prodops: leaving monitoring alerts up for 2 hours, hitting me if we see repeated similar events.

helen-ml: also adding a regression test to our evals: same conversation id repeated requests must not change safety posture when run sequentially. will PR today.

anna-cs: thanks everyone. I'll close the loop with customer after the RCA. :white_check_mark:
